import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static int my_find(String s, String sub, int start) {
        int pos = s.indexOf(sub, start);
        return pos;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = scanner.nextLine();
        int atPos = my_find(input, "at", 1);
        String temp = input.substring(0, atPos) + '@' + input.substring(atPos + 2);
        int dotPos = my_find(temp, "dot", 1);
        int last = 0;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        while (dotPos != -1 && dotPos < temp.length() - 3) {
            result.append(temp.substring(last, dotPos)).append(".");
            last = dotPos + 3;
            dotPos = my_find(temp, "dot", last);
        }
        result.append(temp.substring(last));
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
